The '''Snowcap flower''', also referred to as the '''Hoth Snowcap''',<ref name="Hoth Snowcap">{{TORcite|type=item|Hoth Snowcap|Snowcap Reward Pouch}}</ref> or simply '''Snowcap''', was a type of delicate blue [[Flower/Legends|flower]] native to the planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. They were named after the [[Snowcap Mountain]], atop of which these flowers could be found. Snowcaps only emerged from the snow during extremely cold temperatures and were regarded a delicacy by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]].<ref name="Snow Capped Delicacies" /><ref name="Snowcap Flower">{{TORcite|type=item|Snowcap Flower|Dynamic Encounter: "Snow Capped Delicacies"}}</ref> Snowcaps were sometimes kept as home-plants.<ref name="decor">{{TORcite|type=other|Decoration: "Hoth Snowcap"}}</ref>
